description: This file serves as the server entry point for a Remix application. It handles incoming HTTP requests, manages CORS headers, differentiates between bot and browser requests, and streams server-side rendered HTML responses using React's server rendering APIs.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main function that processes incoming requests, sets CORS headers, handles preflight OPTIONS requests, and delegates rendering to bot or browser specific handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server rendering for bot user-agents by streaming HTML content directly to the response.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server rendering for browser user-agents by streaming HTML content directly to the response.
